Name: Seven Deadly Sins-English Translation for 1.6 (Unofficial)
Author: shelbasaur093
Description:
Initially I used [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20435]Transtar[/url] to translate the mod for my own use, but the translation came out extremely poor and I quickly realized I would have to rewrite EVERYTHING in order for it to be at all playable (T^T) and i saw absolutely no point into putting THAT much work into something that i didn't plan on sharing, so share I shall (with permission of course).
COMPLETE CHANGE 0.0
I was shared this continuation of Cassallate's translation, to share with you all along with translated PNGs for buttons and menus!!
all credit to Ricehit, Cassallate and the SDS discord! (of which i am not a member, as the only real socializing i do is in Stardew. so Blessed be to all involved, I am merely a messenger ~^.^~)
